ac_cloud.title: Midea cloud
ac_cloud.description: The air conditioner needs a token and key for local control. The integration downloads them once from the cloud of the app the unit is registered in (MSmartHome = SmartHome). The password is not stored. Without your own account, tick the default account – you then enter the unit ID manually.

ac_lan.title: Air conditioner from Midea AC LAN
ac_lan.description: Token and key are taken from the Midea AC LAN integration. Give indoor units sharing one outdoor unit (multi-split) the same outdoor unit name.

appliance.title: Midea cloud
appliance.description: Dehumidifiers, water heaters, fans, purifiers and other Midea appliances (types from the MSmartHome app) are controlled locally through the midea-local library. The integration signs in once to download the token and key of the appliance; the password is not stored. These device types are untested.

error.no_appliances_found: No supported Midea appliance found on the account.
error.cannot_connect_appliance: The appliance does not answer (IP address, token/key, or it is not on the local network).
